statement.zh-TW: 能計算並解讀負債比率與長期資金占固定資產比率，說出兩者各回答什麼問題
statement.en: Calculate and interpret the debt ratio and the long-term funds to property, plant and equipment ratio, and say what question each one answers

text.zh-TW: 把負債比率的分母當成股東權益，算成負債除以權益
text.en: Using equity as the denominator of the debt ratio, so it becomes liabilities divided by equity

text.zh-TW: 以為長期資金只有非流動負債，忘了加股東權益
text.en: Thinking long-term funds means only non-current liabilities and forgetting to add equity

text.zh-TW: 以為負債比率越低一定越好，或低負債就等於會賺錢
text.en: Assuming a lower debt ratio is always better, or that low debt means the business is profitable

statement.zh-TW: 能算出三個現金流量類指標（現金流量比率、允當比率的單期近似、再投資比率）並說明各自的意義
statement.en: Work out the three cash flow ratios (the cash flow ratio, the single-period approximation of the adequacy ratio and the reinvestment ratio) and explain what each one means

text.zh-TW: 把本期淨利當成現金流量比率的分子
text.en: Using profit for the period as the numerator of the cash flow ratio

text.zh-TW: 現金流量允當比率的分母漏掉存貨增加額或現金股利
text.en: Leaving the increase in inventories or cash dividends out of the denominator of the cash flow adequacy ratio

text.zh-TW: 以為存貨減少也要放進允當比率的分母，把分母縮小
text.en: Thinking a decrease in inventories should also enter the adequacy denominator and shrink it

statement.zh-TW: 能說明「算不出來」（N/A）和「算得出來但剛好是零」（0）為什麼是兩回事，並各舉一個報表上的例子
statement.en: Explain why ‘cannot be calculated’ (N/A) and ‘calculated and exactly zero’ (0) are different things, and give an example of each from the statements

text.zh-TW: 把 N/A 填成 0，或把兩者當成同一回事
text.en: Entering 0 instead of N/A, or treating the two as the same thing

text.zh-TW: 以為分母為零時比率「趨近無限大」，可以當成滿分
text.en: Thinking a ratio with a zero denominator ‘tends to infinity’ and counts as a perfect score

text.zh-TW: 以為 N/A 代表資料有錯或公司表現很差
text.en: Thinking N/A means the data are wrong or the company is doing badly

statement.zh-TW: 用課程參考值判讀指標高低時，能說明例外產業與參考值的限制，不把參考值當成法規門檻
statement.en: When using course reference values to judge a ratio, explain the exceptions by industry and the limits of reference values, rather than treating them as legal thresholds

text.zh-TW: 把課程參考值當成法規規定的門檻
text.en: Treating course reference values as thresholds set by law

text.zh-TW: 不看產業就判定高於參考值的公司有危險
text.en: Declaring a company dangerous for exceeding a reference value without looking at its industry

text.zh-TW: 以為落在參考值內就不必再追問其他報表
text.en: Assuming that a ratio inside the reference range means nothing else needs checking
